homepage.title: Mobile Developer : Android | IOS | Kotlin | Flutter | Kotlin Multiplatform | Java
homepage.description:
Developer with proven experience in high-impact projects — from mobile applications with a university patent to systems for the SSPDS of Ceará and AI research at Samsung.

Specialized in native mobile development for Android and wearables (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Flutter/Dart), with expertise in robust architectures such as MVVM, dependency injection, complete testing pyramid, and automated CI/CD pipelines.

On the back-end, experience with highly complex microservices in Java Spring Boot and WebFlux, orchestration with Docker and Kubernetes, messaging with Apache Kafka, and REST APIs for platforms.
Also active in health tech with Samsung Health SDK integration, physiological signal processing with NeuroKit, and Firebase monitoring — actively contributing to the Samsung AI4Wellness project, with a stable app in continuous use by the Insight Data Science Lab.

Quality-driven profile, with deliverables including 80%+ test coverage, published scientific articles, a university patent (UFC), and systems in real production.

about.intro_mobile: I am a Mid-level Developer focused on Android, IOS and mobile technologies, specialized in Kotlin, Java and Flutter.
about.experience_android: I have solid experience in the development of native applications for Android and wearables, using Jetpack Compose, MVVM, Retrofit and Samsung Health SDK, in addition to implementing CI/CD practices, monitoring and data analysis to ensure high quality and performance.
about.experience_backend: I complement my work in mobile with Back-End development in Spring Boot (Java) and Python (FastAPI/Flask), creating scalable RESTful APIs and microservices with Docker and Kubernetes.
about.experience_data: I have knowledge in data analysis with Python, physiological signal processing with NeuroKit and application of Graph Theory in connectivity and optimization solutions.
